comment: IEEE 802.15.4 PHY header: the PSDU's length in octets (7 bits) and a reserved bit, then the PSDU (the MAC frame, its 2-octet FCS included), every octet least significant bit first. The FCS is the MAC's, inside the PSDU: a capture hands it to Wireshark (LINKTYPE_IEEE802_15_4_WITHFCS), which checks it
